name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in Oracle: VARRAY and nested table collections, object types and the native JSON type. Oracle has no map type, so the map columns and the list of maps are JSON. The dialectType of a collection or object column is its structure (ARRAY(...), ROW(...)), the type name is in the description; typeFamily is the family of the root.

columns.name: tags
columns.label: Tags
columns.description: List of text values as a VARRAY (ordered, at most 100); elements are addressed 1-based in PL/SQL, in SQL through TABLE()

columns.name: vec
columns.label: Vector
columns.description: VARRAY of doubles (three values); a VARRAY has a maximum, not a fixed size

columns.name: matrix
columns.label: Matrix
columns.description: A VARRAY of VARRAYs: two rows of three doubles; the first index selects the row

columns.name: dims
columns.label: Dimensions
columns.description: Object type cx_dims of width and height

columns.name: address
columns.label: Address
columns.description: Object type cx_address holding an object (cx_geo) and a list (phones)
columns.dialectType: ROW(street VARCHAR2(100), geo ROW(lat BINARY_DOUBLE, lon BINARY_DOUBLE), phones ARRAY(VARCHAR2(100)))

columns.name: attrs
columns.label: Attributes
columns.description: Map as a JSON object with text keys; Oracle has no map type

columns.name: counts
columns.label: Counts
columns.description: Map as a JSON object with numeric values; Oracle has no map type

columns.name: lookup
columns.label: Lookup
columns.description: Map as a JSON object; the integer keys are text, as JSON has no other

columns.name: items
columns.label: Items
columns.description: Nested table of object type cx_item: sku, quantity, price and a list of options
columns.dialectType: ARRAY(ROW(sku VARCHAR2(20), qty INTEGER, price NUMBER(10,2), opts ARRAY(VARCHAR2(100))))

columns.name: events
columns.label: Events
columns.description: VARRAY of object type cx_event with temporal fields

columns.name: deep
columns.label: Deep
columns.description: A list of maps whose values are structures holding a list and a map of lists; JSON as a whole, since it contains maps

columns.name: doc
columns.label: Document
columns.description: JSON document in the native JSON type; JSON paths count from 0

columns.name: odd
columns.label: Odd
columns.description: Object type cx_odd with a mixed-case attribute name that needs quoting
